title: Smiling Man in Tailored Suit, California Palm - Vintage 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot of a cheerful man dressed in a dark tailored three-piece suit and patterned necktie. He is smiling warmly while standing in front of dense, sunny palm fronds, likely on vacation or enjoying the warm climate of Southern California or Florida during the late Roaring Twenties.
